_readme: Accounts and sites known to publish AI-generated content.
This ships EMPTY on purpose. Labelling a real account as an 'AI slop channel'
is a factual claim about someone, and shipping unverified names would be
defamatory and would produce false positives users cannot audit. Users build
this list themselves via the shroud's 'block this author' action, the context
menu, or the options page; a curated community list can be added later behind
Entry format: '@handle' (matched case-insensitively, without the '@') or a
platform-stable id such as a YouTube channel id 'UCxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx'.
